title: Roche Inks USD 813 Mn Deal with Zymeworks for Experimental Lung Cancer Drug ZW209

contentHtml:
Bengaluru: Zymeworks said on Friday Roche has gained rights to develop and commercialize its experimental lung cancer drug under a global licensing deal worth up to USD 813 million.

Zymeworks will receive $55 million upfront and an additional $40 million when the Swiss drugmaker begins a planned dose-optimization study of the drug ZW209

Roche will take over the development of the treatment after Zymeworks completes the dose-escalation portion of an ongoing early-stage study

The company said the drug targets DLL3, a protein commonly found on small-cell lung cancer cells but rarely seen in healthy tissue.

Roche has agreed to partner on ZW209 before efficacy data were available because of "the innovation and differentiation in our trispecific T-cell engager platform," Zymeworks CEO Kenneth Galbraith told Reuters

The first patient is expected to be enrolled before the end of 2026, Galbraith said

The company said it could receive up to $718 million in development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments, in addition to tiered royalties on future sales.

Source : Reuters
